generated.description: A large French countryside mansion built from white wool, stone brick, bricks and oak leaves, with green wool and spruce roofing and grassy, podzol-covered grounds around it. At about 107 by 31 by 88 blocks it is a sprawling estate, with a stone-brick terrace and a few furnished interior details such as chests, furnaces and flower pots. It is a Tropical Biome Sprint (TBS) entry from the WoK project and its source has no description.
